user.title: Connect to the Mira agent
user.description: Address and API token of the Mira agent (server.listen and server.token in its config).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Mira found
zeroconf_confirm.description: A Mira agent announced itself at {url}. Enter its API token (server.token).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the agent at this address.

abort.no_id: The agent did not announce an id; update it.

data_description.timeout: After this the satellite says a short error instead of staying silent.
data_description.sidebar: Mira's web UI as a page in Home Assistant; who is no admin sees only their memory, the house's and the guide. Each user can also hide it in their own sidebar.

persons.title: Settings for persons
persons.description: Every person in Home Assistant is a person for Mira too. Expand one and set what Mira needs on top; it is stored on the person itself. Left empty, there are no settings. {error}

data.alone_is_me: Alone at home, the satellites are me

data_description.alone_is_me: When you are the only person at home, Mira treats the voice satellites as you: your memory, your private messages.
data_description.channels: Notify targets that are this person's, in order: e.g. a chat of HA's Telegram integration, the companion app. Personal messages go to the first that works; a Telegram chat here is also how Mira knows the person when they write.
data_description.accept_from: Messages from people; Mira's own (tasks, reminders, warnings) always arrive.

satellites.title: Settings for satellites
satellites.description: Every Assist satellite with an area speaks in its area. Expand one and set what comes on top; it is stored on the satellite itself, the room is its area. {error}

data_description.presence: Motion at any of them starts an announcement, e.g. hallway and living room.
data_description.morning: The first motion after quiet hours announces what is pending.
data_description.mode: Announce speaks messages when someone comes in; indicate only lights the indicator, and you ask "Do you have a notification?". Urgent messages and reminders are always spoken.
data_description.indicator: Shows waiting messages, e.g. the LED ring of the satellite.

abort.not_loaded: The Mira agent entry is not loaded.
abort.no_persons: There are no persons in Home Assistant yet.
abort.no_satellites: There is no Assist satellite with an area.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Queue a message. The agent announces it on a satellite when someone is in a room, or sends it privately.

text.name: Text
text.description: What to say, one or two spoken sentences.

details.name: Details
details.description: The long form, for follow-up questions.

importance.name: Importance
importance.description: 0 not worth mentioning, 1 by the way, 2 important today, 3 urgent.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.description: house, or a person: the HA person id (e.g. anna).

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidential messages are only spoken when the agent policy allows it, otherwise sent privately.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: An open message with the same key is updated instead of duplicated.

expires_in.name: Expires in
expires_in.description: Duration like 12h; afterwards the message is dropped. Default 24h.

task.name: Task
task.description: The automation's id ({{ this.attributes.id }}): the message shows in the task's log.

assess.name: Assess
assess.description: Mira judges what happened against the goal, with the data she looks up and condenses; if it is worth it, she words a message and delivers it like any other. Answers importance, spoken and message_id.

goal.name: Goal
goal.description: What this task is for, in the user's words.

data.name: Data
data.description: List of entries with entity_id and view; view state, same_hour (last hour against the same hour on 14 days) or day (today so far against the same weekdays).

memory.name: Memory
memory.description: relevant: profile and matching facts; profile; none.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Like 6h: within it the task only reports again when it gets more important.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Off: only the verdict, no message (dry run).

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.description: house, or a person: the HA person id (e.g. anna).

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidential messages are only spoken when the agent policy allows it.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: An open message with the same key is updated instead of duplicated.

task.name: Task
task.description: The automation's id ({{ this.attributes.id }}): its judgements share a log and earlier verdicts.

decide.name: Decide
decide.description: Mira answers a yes/no question with the data she looks up; no message. Use with response_variable and a template condition.

data.name: Data
data.description: List of entries with entity_id and view, as for Assess.
